episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: 1860: As an Italian army advances from the north to conquer Sicily, the Prince of Salina contends with his nephew's decision to fight for the enemy.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hoping to obtain a travel permit to Donnafugata, the Salinas attend Garibaldi's Liberation Ball, where Tancredi sees others vie for Concetta's affection.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tancredi's attraction to Angelica pulls him away from Concetta. Despite his distaste for Mayor Sedara, Don Fabrizio considers joint future prospects.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: While Concetta distances herself from her family, the Leopard entrusts more responsibilities to Paolo, whom Sedara informs of an enticing venture.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Still grieving, the Prince and Concetta travel to Turin, where a role in Italy's future awaits him. Tancredi and Angelica expose their ambitions.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As Concetta makes her wish to leave Sicily clear, the Leopard silently endures health troubles. The Salinas attend the final ball of the season.
